slug: wes_romaw_the_incident
title: Wes Romaw - The Incident
authors: Silas
season: FF3
format: prose
---

“*I can’t believe I’m really doing this*,” I thought. But I need the money.

“Eight laps left in the race, folks, and it looks like it’s gonna be close! Kenny’s been in the lead for a bit, but Myrnar looks to be gaining!”

God, the announcers have always been annoying… My heart is pounding, but there’s no time to waste. I need to set up.

“Oh, there’s action just behind Myrnar! Someone’s making a big play, Ron!”

“It looks like Romaw is stepping it up, look at him go, passing Tennen, getting up to seventh… he’s passing Wattson, grabbing the sixth place…!”

Lay flat on the ground. Legs separated, feet down.

“And it looks like Romaw has made it all the way up to third place, folks, and it looks like Myrnar’s starting to notice! Only five laps remain, but this race could go anywhere, don’t you think, Doc?”

Get a clean sight picture, right through the support beams on the megascreen.

“My goodness, Ron, are you seein’ what I’m seein’?”

“Doc, it looks to me like Myrnar is slowing down, allowing Romaw to pass him! This is unheard of!”

Open the case. Remove the weapon. My chest is pounding.

“Romaw is still gaining, what a rush! Kenny must be sweating!”

“What’s this? Myrnar is keeping close behind Romaw!”

It amazes me how these announcers are surprised by the same old tactics every time. Whatever. I came here for one thing.

“He’s drafting, Ron! Looks like he’s waiting for the right moment to slingshot around Romaw!”

To kill the top racers.

“Two laps left, but it looks like some other racers are having the same idea as Myrnar! Rothman, Nynja, and Drews are all gaining!”

“And it looks like Myrnar has done it! He’s passed Romaw and- and- and he’s passing Kenny! What a turn of events!”

“Just one lap left, Doc! This is incredible!”

They’ll be getting out, and standing...there. Load the bullet.

“Looks like Rothman and Nynja are gaining on Romaw, while Kenny fights for his first place position with Myrnar! This is incredible!”

Just breathe.

“And there’s the checkered flag! Myrnar, Kenny, Rothman, Nynja, Romaw, Drews, Jennen, Laxton! It’s over!”

The crowd is going wild. Should do nicely as audio cover. Soon enough, I see the racers get out.

Take aim...

Fire.

An ear-piercing “*BLAM*” is heard before Myrnar drops to the floor, clutching the trophy.

“*Shit…I forgot my earplugs*,” I thought. This could be bad. No time to waste, though.

Pull the bolt. Take aim.

The screams of the public ring out as I take aim...my vision is shaky…

“*BLAM*”

Fuck. I missed. Kenny ducks and tries to run for cover.

Pull the bolt. Take aim.

“*BLAM*”

Kenny’s brains splatter on the ground. 150,000 Ducketts so far.

Pull the bolt. Take aim…where’d Rothman go?

Oh well. Fourth place should do nicely.

“*BLAM*”

Nynja’s dead. 225,000 Ducketts.

I begin to hear the sounds of armed guards approaching over the ringing of my ears.

But I’m so close to 300K. I have to fit one more.

Pull the bolt. Take aim. Romaw’s next.

“*BLAM*”

Damnit, missed again. I’ve got to move.

“You take the left, I’ll go right!” They’re coming for me. Store the weapon. Lock the case. Fold up the bipod.

“You! Stop where you are!”

A pulse sniper would have been much more convenient, but nope. Client insisted on a bolt-action sniper. Time to get out of here.

But by the time I’m back to my disposable vehicle, I’m hit twice. In the chest.

“Stop now or we will be forced to use lethal force!”

I have no choice but to do as he says. It’s either that or bleed out on the street. Guards never seem to know just how little it takes to kill a damn Anole.

Guess the extra cash wasn’t worth it.
